sn14.31:1.2: pubbeva me bhikkhave, sambodhā anabhisambuddhassa bodhisattasseva sato etadahosi:
sn14.31:1.3: ko nu kho paṭhavīdhātuyā assādo ko ādīnavo kiṃ nissaraṇaṃ?
sn14.31:1.4: ko āpodhātuyā assādo ko ādīnavo kiṃ nissaraṇaṃ?
sn14.31:1.5: ko tejodhātuyā assādo ko ādīnavo kiṃ nissaraṇaṃ?
sn14.31:1.6: ko vāyodhātuyā assādo ko ādīnavo kiṃ nissaraṇanti?
sn14.31:2.2: yaṃ kho paṭhavīdhātuṃ paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassaṃ, ayaṃ paṭhavīdhātuyā assādo,
sn14.31:2.3: yaṃ paṭhavīdhātu aniccā dukkhā vipariṇāmadhammā, ayaṃ paṭhavīdhātuyā ādīnavo.
sn14.31:2.4: yo paṭhavīdhātuyā chandarāgavinayo chandarāgappahāṇaṃ, idaṃ paṭhavīdhātuyā nissaraṇaṃ.
sn14.31:2.7: yaṃ vāyodhātuṃ paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassaṃ, ayaṃ vāyodhātuyā assādo.
sn14.31:2.8: yaṃ vāyodhātu aniccā dukkhā vipariṇāmadhammā, ayaṃ vāyodhātuyā ādīnavo.
sn14.31:2.9: yo vāyodhātuyā chandavirāgavinayo chandarāgappahāṇaṃ, idaṃ vāyodhātuyā nissaraṇaṃ.
sn14.31:3.1: yāvakīvañcāhaṃ bhikkhave, imāsaṃ catunnaṃ dhātūnaṃ evaṃ assādañca assādato ādīnavañca ādīnavato nissaraṇañca nissaraṇato yathābhūtaṃ nābbhaññāsiṃ, neva tāvāhaṃ bhikkhave, sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake, sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddho paccaññāsiṃ.
sn14.31:4.1: yato ca khohaṃ bhikkhave, imāsaṃ catunnaṃ dhātūnaṃ evaṃ assādañca assādato ādīnavañca ādīnavato nissaraṇañca nissaraṇato yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ, athāhaṃ bhikkhave, sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake, sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadeva manussāya anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddho paccaññāsiṃ.
sn14.31:4.3: “akuppā me cetovimutti ayamantimā jāti. natthidāni punabbhavo”ti.
